messages.请填写实际凭据，不要填写脱敏占位符。: Enter the actual credential, not a redacted placeholder.
messages.访问凭据为空或过长，请重新填写。: The access credential is empty or too long. Enter it again.
messages.这项凭据引用不属于当前对话或接收服务，请重新提供对应服务的访问凭据。: This credential reference does not belong to this conversation or service. Provide access credentials for the intended service.
messages.API method 仅支持 GET 或 POST。: The API method must be GET or POST.
messages.POST 只能选择 json_body 或 form_body，不能同时设置。: Choose either json_body or form_body for POST, not both.
messages.请求体仅用于 POST；GET 参数请放入 query。: Request bodies are supported for POST. Put GET parameters in query.
messages.网页请求由 browser.actions 控制，不设置 API method: Browser requests are controlled by browser.actions. Do not set an API method or request body.
messages.cursor_location 仅支持 query 或 body。: cursor_location must be query or body.
messages.body 游标需要 POST 对象请求体。: A body cursor requires an object body in a POST request.
messages.json_body 必须是 JSON 对象或数组，form_body 必须是对象: json_body must be a JSON object or array. form_body must be an object.
messages.请求体嵌套不能超过20层。: Request bodies cannot exceed 20 levels of nesting.
messages.请求体字段名必须是字符串。: Request body field names must be strings.
messages.请求体认证字段请引用已保存凭据，如 {\"credential\":\"pass: Reference saved credentials in authentication fields, for example {"credential":"password"}. Do not enter plaintext secrets or redacted placeholders.
messages.请求体只支持 JSON 数据。: Request bodies support JSON data only.
messages.请先保存访问凭据，再在请求体使用 credential 引用。: Save the access credentials first, then use credential references in the request body.
messages.form_body 的值须为字符串、字符串数组或 credential 引用。: form_body values must be strings, arrays of strings, or credential references.
messages.请求体必须是有限有效 JSON。: The request body must be valid JSON with finite numbers.
messages.请求体不能超过40000字节。: The request body cannot exceed 40000 bytes.
messages.请求体不能同时使用 JSON 和表单。: A request body cannot use JSON and form encoding at the same time.
messages.credential 须为 username/password 或 名称.use: credential must be username/password or name.username/name.password.
messages.当前 API 配置的 URL、query、请求方式或请求体与已读取样例不一致。先: The API URL, query, method, or body differs from the sampled request. Probe the actual request again before validating its mapping.
messages.API 请求未成功；核对文档中的端点、请求方式、查询参数与请求体，不要猜测: The API request failed. Check the documented endpoint, method, query parameters, and request body. Do not guess.
